title: Dive the Sea of Cortez with Monik Saab

blocks.title: Dive the Sea of Cortez with Monik Saab
blocks.lede: For certified divers. Dive, sail and sleep at anchor off Espíritu Santo, with a small group of up to 8 guests on board. 3 or 5 days: November 20 to 22, or November 25 to 29.
blocks.imageAlt: Monike Saab Expedition Leader expert in scubadiving in La Paz

blocks.body:
### **WHO IS MONIK**

\
She grew up on a beach in Brazil and spent sixteen years in large corporations and teaching English before she made the sea her work.

Ask her what keeps her there and she sums it up in one line:

> "In the ocean, everybody helps everybody. I wish it were like that on land."

Monik will take small groups of divers out on the Sea of Cortez with Eagle Ray. On board, she watches before she speaks: who is relaxed, who checks their gear twice, who wants to go deeper.\
Then she plans the dives around them. Which site, how deep, when to get in, and when the best thing is to stay on deck and watch the light go.

Today she is a PADI dive instructor and a licensed expedition guide in Mexico.\
Six years diving Baja California Sur, one of them living in La Paz. A license to guide in the Revillagigedo Islands.\
Seasons on yachts with helicopter decks. Dive briefings in English, Spanish, Portuguese or German.

Follow her dives at [@nikdive](https://www.instagram.com/nikdive/)
